items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know Bingie until I went to sit in over there, the Tango Palace

ctx.x: So they had to lower that down to save Bingie. So I heard about the story but I didn't know Bingie until I went to sit in over there, the Tango Palace, and I saw this fellow and we're talking about Louis Armstrong when he was there. I wasn't with him then, you know, but Bingie was, had been, and he was the band leader there at the Tango Palace. He told me the story himself, about his ankle.
About his ankle. Okay, Ernie Fields came through and he offered you a job and you went.
